The observed scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the direct interaction between Lindenanolide G and Lysine-specific demethylase 2A, followed by the target of that enzyme and Prelamin-A/C. The mechanism appears to involve a cascade of enzymatic interactions, where Lindenanolide G indirectly affects Prelamin-A/C through its impact on the demethylase activity. This integrated pathway highlights the role of Lysine-specific demethylase 2A as a critical mediator in the relationship between Lindenanolide G and Prelamin-A/C.
